result: Disabled native-format active-prefix preview and full-stream snapshot reader implemented and checked on synthetic reference data.
full_stream_behavior: Checks all active rows before selecting target body; dynamic solver adjacency is not an input to collection. Kinematic records are retained even with an empty dynamic adjacency list. Inactive tail rows are ignored according to active count.
dtype_policy: Represent float32 vectors and int32 counters/indices via standard-library serialization; reject overflow/nonfinite values. Report rounding and weight/normal consistency deviations without renormalization or conversion qualification.
duplicate_policy: Raw records preserved; exact duplicate report remains separate and cannot hide overflow.
limitations: No owned live-state capture or IPC implementation.
No actual native buffer allocation/write/read round-trip performed.
Body pose comes from provided reference context; native pose/frame/time coherence remains unvalidated.
No replay tids, history/reset registry or float32 acceptance budget established.
Hash agreement cannot authenticate runtime or physical validity.
No reaction force, contact solver or robot integration.
next_step: A guarded native-buffer round-trip and read-only capture comparison using disclosed synthetic records, with zero physics/force calls; do not yet enable force-producing contacts.
